title: Paired Non-Stationary Target Shift Recovery
intuition: Tests whether a converged multimodal model adapts cleanly when the target distribution shifts mid-run, verified against a paired frozen-target control to confirm genuine adaptation rather than noisy drift.
failure_mode: Over-settled optimizers or frozen priors fail to migrate particles to the shifted modes within the recovery deadline, while unstable recipes fail the stationary pre-shift checks.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence Law 3 anchor; paired adaptation evaluator with recovery deadline.
